Method of Attack: Installed manually by attackers hacking into computers over Remote Desktop Protocol Services (RDP)
Brute force password attack on RDP (TCP port 3389)
Encrypts mapped network drives, shared virtual machine host drives, and unmapped network shares
Creates ransom notes (Info.hta and FILES ENCRYPTED.txt)
Configures itself to auto-start on Windows login to encrypt new files
Impacted Systems: Windows computers accessed via Remote Desktop Services
Attack Vector: Hacked Remote Desktop Services (RDP) with brute force password attacks
